evidence.decision: Chooses a short parent-related task versus complex editing or repeated adjustment, then distinguishes save/exit/step-back outcomes.
evidence.artifact: Requires task/exit/size implementation or a step-and-exit contract with detents, parent availability and data outcomes.
evidence.transformation: Medium-only composer example replaces stacked attachment sheets and exit-as-Back with a large composer, internal steps and clear Cancel/Done/Back roles.
evidence.verification: Tests edited/clean gesture dismissal, Back, completion, resize and replacement; fails draft loss, stacking or Back that exits the task.
evidence.applicability: Preserves iOS/iPad nonmodal options, Mac parent-only blocking, visionOS centered contextual placement and brief watch task limits.
evidence.handoffs: Selects modality, action-sheets, panels or windows according to actual task length and exit needs.
evidence.distinctiveness: Detents, parent scope and the separate meanings of Cancel/Done/Back provide an operational sheet contract beyond general modal advice.
